facts.fact: Ansel 办公室：桌上摆着去年十月、她消失前不久他拍的照片——走在 Elasia 前面、笑着转来转去、金卷发
facts.anchor: staring at the picture on his desk of Kaylee

facts.fact: 他从第一次见面就想要她——一直在打持久战，指望她在他世界里越久就越想加入
facts.anchor: he’d been playing the long game

facts.fact: Wyatt 没能让她参与任何一票 shipment；Kaylee 处处 rebuff Ansel
facts.anchor: Only Wyatt hadn’t been able to convince her

facts.fact: 她消失当晚他杀了 Elasia 与 Wyatt——两年来一直等联邦上门；办公室里灯里的 bug 也没抓到东西
facts.anchor: expecting the other shoe to drop

facts.fact: 他的组织靠恐惧运转——一旦手下不再怕他，他就会跪下、然后脑上一枪
facts.anchor: His entire operation ran on fear

facts.fact: Harlan 脸上留着当年摸 Kaylee 后挨的那一拳疤；但他 loyal as a dog；一帮人在为遥控器打架
facts.anchor: scar where Ansel hit him with his fist

facts.fact: 有人喊停电视——Clyde 指着人群里一张脸：Small Town USA 圣诞特辑、Idaho 小镇、正在点巨型土豆
facts.anchor: Clyde pointed to a face in the crowd

facts.fact: Ansel 缓缓露出满足的笑——Sweet Kaylee
